en-GB.bird_lore_barnowl: This appears to be some distant cousin of the Stygiforme! Alas, I've only read tales of those great beasts. Though I've of course -been- to Starglass, I've never been permitted to the peaks or halls of the mountains, where the Faahri live. The humans living in the foothill cities seem quite protective of their neighbours!
en-GB.bird_lore_crownedeagle:
I've longed to see an eagle up close for years!

But now that I've finally managed it, I find their song is... rather pathetic, really. 

'Never meet your heroes,' I suppose.
en-GB.bird_lore_hummingbird:
A rather distinctive tropical bird. 
It deters its predators with a frightening cry that sounds too massive to come from such a small body.
en-GB.bird_lore_king_eider: Ah, it's been ages since I've seen this one. Named after the first and last monarch of Felheim. In ancient times, Felheim split from Cherrystone and became a kingdom all its own. But after the Fell Gauntlet was recovered from that unassuming burial site, the monarchy came to a sudden and brutal end.
en-GB.bird_lore_kingfisher:
A blue -bird- to be sure, but not a bluebird. (There's only one of those for me anyhow!)
Didn't Emeric gift me a Lordling once? His idea of a joke, if I
recall - I'd only just ascended the throne. 

Simpler days!
en-GB.bird_lore_kiwi:
A curious one. These birds don't -hatch- from eggs, so to speak...

Rather, when the chick is ready, hairlike feathers begin to sprout from the eggshell one by one.  
As the bird grows, the eggshell dissolves into the chick's skin. 

Nature is certainly full of wonder!
en-GB.bird_lore_pigeon: Likely the most charming and beloved bird in all the land! People often raise them to compete in math tournaments.
en-GB.bird_lore_puffin:
From afar, one wonders how these darling little birds survive in a place like Felheim! But then, you see it:

The teeth. Myden's beard, those TEETH! By the time the Snuffin unhinges its jaw, I'm sure its prey *wishes* it were dead!
en-GB.bird_lore_raven:
There are old tales of witches who knew the Noxel's song so well, they could transform into Noxels themselves!

As the legend goes, you can easily tell a true Noxel from a human - Noxels are smarter.
en-GB.bird_lore_robotality:
This isn't a bird at all! Yet it flies all the same... 

Could this be the fabled technology of the Faahri Republic? I hope they aren't spying on us...
en-GB.bird_lore_sparrowbomb:
What sort of contraption...? Ah, it must be some Heavensong child's lost toy.

Oh, if only Mercia were still but a babe, I'd take this home for her nursery!
en-GB.bird_lore_toucan:
A favorite of the late Emperor, perhaps for their rarity.

They're said to have been quite common in Saffron before it joined Heavensong, but for some reason sightings have become fewer and fewer over the years.
en-GB.bird_lore_woodpecker:
Their beaks are strong enough to penetrate even Eldertree bark.
I'm far too squeamish to confirm, but by adulthood their blood is said to be thirty percent sap!

I'm sure if you cut -me- open, my blood would be seventy percent liquorice.
